operation.summary: The linked Bridgits (the owner's other Bridgits) you may use through this one, with what each lets you do. Any call takes header X-Bridgit-Target: <name> (the linked Bridgit's Device Domain Name, or its sat: id) or query target=<name> to run on that Bridgit instead of this one; leave it out to use this one. Calls are passed on once: a linked Bridgit never passes them further.
operation.returns: links[{id (sat:… or name), target, link_id, name, bridgit_name, kind, platform, device_type, status (online|offline|unlinked|not_checked), state (on|waiting_for_target|waiting_for_user|paused|off), services[], last_seen, battery, cameras, capabilities, endpoints, how_to_call}], how_to_call. Only Bridgits the owner lets you use are listed; GET /v1/satellites is the same list.
